name: Albert Bierstadt · Sublime Landscapes and Dusk

features.label: Convincing volume
features.explanation: Keep original subject contours and volumes, modeling major forms with light and shadow
features.evidence: Broad low-value rock walls, cloud undersides and trees support localized golden-yellow or creamy-white illuminated areas. Light often enters through breaks in clouds or a valley opening, then passes across haze, water and rocky slopes; the brightest area becomes the eye’s destination.
features.zh: 保持原有主体轮廓与体积，以明暗塑造大形
features.en: Keep original subject contours and volumes, modeling major forms with light and shadow

features.label: Near and distant edges
features.explanation: Keep nearby contours clear and gradually soften distant edges
features.evidence: Foreground bark, leaf clusters, rocks and grass have fine but uneven variations. Strong contours concentrate nearby or in silhouettes. Distant contours and textures gradually disappear, avoiding equal clarity at every distance.
features.zh: 近处轮廓清楚，远处轮廓逐渐柔化
features.en: Keep nearby contours clear and gradually soften distant edges

features.label: Warm gold and cool gray
features.explanation: Contrast golden warm light with cool gray-blue, deep green and brown-violet shadows
features.evidence: Clouds have clearly articulated volumes, with edges shifting from warm light to cool gray-blue and brown-violet. Distant mountains are paler and softer, while haze reduces distant contrast; the golden orange of evening light works with deep green and cool gray shadows.
features.zh: 以金黄暖光对照冷灰蓝、深绿与褐紫暗部
features.en: Contrast golden warm light with cool gray-blue, deep green and brown-violet shadows

features.label: Light breaking through
features.explanation: Support a localized luminous area with broad deep shadows and coherent lighting
features.evidence: Broad low-value rock walls, cloud undersides and trees support localized golden-yellow or creamy-white illuminated areas. Light often enters through breaks in clouds or a valley opening, then passes across haze, water and rocky slopes; the brightest area becomes the eye’s destination.
features.zh: 让大面积深影承托局部明亮光域，保留光线逻辑
features.en: Support a localized luminous area with broad deep shadows and coherent lighting

features.label: Atmospheric perspective
features.explanation: Within the original composition, strengthen atmospheric perspective with darker, sharper foregrounds and lighter, softer distance
features.evidence: Trunks, rocks, grassy slopes and overlaps establish an entry into the foreground. Luminous lakes, grassland or streams unfold in the middle ground, while the distance fades in stages into mountains and cloud. Deer, bison and tiny figures make nature appear vast.
features.zh: 在原构图中加强近深远浅、近实远虚的空气透视
features.en: Within the original composition, strengthen atmospheric perspective with darker, sharper foregrounds and lighter, softer distance

features.label: Selective detail
features.explanation: Keep varied fine detail nearby and gradually reduce texture in the distance
features.evidence: Foreground bark, leaf clusters, rocks and grass have fine but uneven variations. Strong contours concentrate nearby or in silhouettes. Distant contours and textures gradually disappear, avoiding equal clarity at every distance.
features.zh: 近处保留细致变化，远处逐渐减少纹理
features.en: Keep varied fine detail nearby and gradually reduce texture in the distance

features.label: Expansive and poetic
features.explanation: Create an expansive, quiet and poetic atmosphere through light and shadow
features.evidence: Attached images 1 and 2 show storms and light through clouds; images 3, 5 and 6 emphasize golden twilight in valleys and around lakes; image 4 organizes prairie scenery with bison, a stream and a tree canopy. Different subjects can produce grandeur without repeating the same kind of peak.
features.zh: 营造宏阔、安静而有诗意的光影氛围
features.en: Create an expansive, quiet and poetic atmosphere through light and shadow

features.label: Keep the original palette
features.explanation: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only value and contrast.
features.evidence: This is an optional variation for creation, not a description of the reference artwork.
features.zh: 保留原图的主要色相关系，只调整色阶与对比
features.en: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only value and contrast

avoid.zh: 不新增原图没有的人物、建筑、动物或道具；不复制参考图题字与水印；避免细节密度平均、材质噪声过重
avoid.en: Do not add people, buildings, animals or props absent from the source; do not copy reference lettering or watermarks; avoid uniform detail density and excessive texture noise
